en.headline: 1 own commit plus 10 automated; 3 issues across SenseNova-Skills and OfficeCLI
en.summary: On 2026-10-05, `sogeisetsu` made **1 own commit** in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, plus 10 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. The commit fixed the daily badge so a 0 commit count is no longer coerced to 1, unified badge layout, and forced inline code in AI summaries. No pull requests or reviews were filed. Three issues were touched: opened `OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills` #180 on OpenCode V2 compatibility for `SKILL.md` frontmatter and runtime assumptions; commented on `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI` #254 about OpenCode detection and skill install path pointing to `~/.opencode` while OpenCode uses `~/.config/opencode`; and opened `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI` #458 to fix the skills install path and add an `mcp` target for OpenCode v2 integration. No releases, stars, replies, or state changes were recorded.

zh.headline: 1 次本人提交加 10 次自动提交；3 个 issue 涉及 SenseNova-Skills 与 OfficeCLI
zh.summary: 2026-10-05，`sogeisetsu` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 完成 **1 次本人提交**，另有 10 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。该提交修复了 daily 徽章在提交数为 0 时被兜底成 1 的问题，统一了徽章排版，并强制 AI 摘要使用内联代码。当日无 PR 与 review。共涉及 3 个 issue：新开 `OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills` #180，讨论 OpenCode V2 下 `SKILL.md` frontmatter 与运行时假设的兼容性；在 `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI` #254 留言，指出 OpenCode 检测与技能安装路径指向 `~/.opencode`，而 OpenCode 实际使用 `~/.config/opencode`；新开 `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI` #458，修复技能安装路径并为 OpenCode v2 集成添加 `mcp` target。当日无 release、star、reply 或状态变更。
